razor_priya: Pattern: I guessed bathroom_shelf_ba1 on day 28 (07:10). Reality: It was at sink_ba_ba1. This is the second consecutive day (after day 27) where I guessed the shelf and it was at the sink. Next time: The item is currently in a "sink" phase. Do not default to the shelf. Check sink_ba_ba1 first. Only switch to shelf if there is very recent evidence of a move.

glass_priya: Pattern: I guessed coffee_table_l1 on day 28 (19:12). Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1. Combined with day 27 errors, this item is highly mobile between kitchen and living areas. Next time: Do not default to coffee_table_l1. Check kitchen_table_k1, counter_k1, and cupboard_k1 with equal weight. If last seen in the living room, assume it has moved to the kitchen.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I guessed coffee_table_l1 on day 28 (19:12). Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1. This confirms the strict swap pattern between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Next time: Continue to check these two spots with equal weight. If last seen at one, assume it has moved to the other. Do not guess other kitchen or living spots.

mug_priya: Pattern: No errors today. Next time: Continue to strictly swap between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Do not guess other spots.

General Note: Avoid rigid location rules for glass_priya, mug_priya, and water_bottle_priya. These items move frequently between kitchen and living areas. For glass_priya, valid spots are counter_k1, kitchen_table_k1, cupboard_k1, coffee_table_l1, and nightstand_b1. For mug_priya and water_bottle_priya, valid spots are strictly kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. For razor_priya, valid spots are sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1. Always prioritize recent specific evidence, but recognize that "recent" may be from a different day if the item rotates. Do not default to bedroom spots for these items.
